'''Volume 64''' is the 64th volume of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga. It is the third volume of the {{MangaArc|Omega Ruby & Alpha Sapphire}}. It is authored by [[Hidenori Kusaka]] and illustrated by [[Satoshi Yamamoto]].

==Trivia==
* {{adv|Amber}} and [[Blaise]] can be seen hidden in the extended cover.<ref>[https://twitter.com/satoshi_swalot/status/1630242600551854080 Tweet from Satoshi Yamamoto showing the extended cover]</ref>
* The English release date for this volume was delayed multiple times. It was initially scheduled to release on November 12, 2024, but was subsequently delayed to May 13, 2025, September 9, 2025, January 1, 2030, back to September 9, 2025, and then to an unknown date. This is likely related to the delayed Japanese release of the following volume.
